'''Level Ten'''<ref name="script">{{Disney|subdomain=assets.debut|url=documents/Andor%20209%20--%20POST%20FINAL%20--%203.3.24%5B1%5D.pdf|text=Episode #209 "Welcome To The Rebellion" Script|format=PDF}}</ref> was a level on the [[Galactic Senate]] [[Imperial Senate Building|Building]].<ref name="Welcome" /> In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|209}}</ref> after [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] made a speech recriminating the [[Galactic Empire]] and [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]], she exited the Senate floor from Level Ten, where she met [[Axis network]] operative [[Cassian Jeron Andor]], who aided her in her escape from the Senate.<ref name="Welcome" />

==Behind the scenes==
Level Ten appeared in "[[Welcome to the Rebellion]]," the ninth episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Welcome" /> on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> It was identified by name in the script for the episode, published on [[Disney Debut]].<ref name="script" />
